north-russia-2021.notes: The pack's problems_known (15 Russian titles A 'Изгороди' to O 'Пожиратель кактусов') do not match this editorial's 14 problems (A 'Anno Domini 2022' to N 'New White-Black Tree'); the pack's list looks like a different contest's. The editorial says the contest was held online on December 11, 2021. A problem-count fact was dropped: the editorial covers 14 problems but does not state how many the contest had.

north-russia-2026.notes: The site holds standings/statements/tutorial pages of the 2026 regional and qualification and of earlier editions (2019-2025); the 2026 standings.html, statements.pdf and tutorial.pdf are candidates for sources of their own. The 2026 qualification (October 25, 328 teams, 15 problems) is a separate round.

sources.evidence: Seed page headed 'Northwestern Russia Regional Contest 2026' giving November 14 at ITMO University, with links to the 2026 standings, statements and tutorial, all of which are in the copy.
